name: TerraNova
source: The endless whirlpool of repetitive cycles becomes familiar all too quickly. And as time goes on, it’s increasingly difficult to find ways to amuse yourself in a world frozen in place. Yet when one of those cycles goes off script, you soon discover that monotony, after all, isn’t such a bad thing.
translation: 重复循环的无尽漩涡很快就变得熟悉起来。随着时间的推移，在一个僵化的世界中找到自娱自乐的方法变得越来越困难。然而，当其中一个周期脱离剧本时，你很快就会发现单调毕竟不是一件坏事。
